name: mixed-language-2
description: German Mittelstand GmbH card, double-sided: page 1 German, page 2 English (same details, translated labels). OCR'd with the app's 'eng' model (no German option), so umlauts survive on the big bold lines (company, name) but degrade on small lines: 'Geschäftsführer' -> 'Geschaftsfiihrer' (ü->ii), 'Straße' -> 'StraBe' (ß->B), 'Frästeile' -> 'Frasteile'. Layout: company with GmbH (largest), German product tagline with dot separators read as '-', 'Dipl.-Ing. Jürgen Schäfer' (degree prefix on the German side only; English side prints plain 'Jürgen Schäfer'), street on its own line (no comma, no ADDR keyword), 'D-73430 Aalen' PLZ+city line, label-first phone block 'Tel. / Fax / Mobil' with +49 (0)-less international format and a national-format mobile '0171 234 56 78', corporate email + www. English side adds 'Managing Director', 'Industriestrasse 14', '73430 Aalen - Germany', duplicate phones (dedupe path), an email with an OCR space before the TLD, and a VAT line 'USt-IdNr.: DE 812 345 678' whose 9-digit group looks like a phone. Stresses: non-ASCII letters in the name (ü/ä), German 'Mobil' label, PLZ-city single-chunk address, European street words, VAT/custom field.
